errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis has a linear scale. The tick marks (1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, 100%) are not spaced according to their numerical value; they are treated as discrete categories with equal spacing on the axis.

The description claims the x-axis tick marks have an interval of 5%, but the actual tick marks are 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, and 100%, which do not have a uniform interval. The description itself lists these non-uniform values, contradicting the claim.
